description: Land Acquisition - Golahela, Kegalle D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition for the construction of an urban park in Kegalle District. It specifically deals with the government's intention to acquire five specific land lots, provides detailed descriptions of each property, lists claimants, and outlines the compensation inquiry process. This content falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisition, property ownership details, and land use for development projects.
